title: "Flow-Maps panels: coverage checks"
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true
execute:
  warning: false
---

Checks the daily tables written by `scripts/1_bha_cases_mobility.R` (read from the full panel tables),
2020-03-01 to 2021-05-01. Render with `quarto render reports/<file>.qmd` from the repository folder.

```{r}
#| include: false
root = normalizePath(if (dir.exists("helpers")) "." else "..")
setwd(root)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
```

```{r}
library(arrow); library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(ggplot2)

cat_panel = read_parquet("outputs/catalunya/panel/cat_abs_full_allcovariates.parquet")
mad_panel = read_parquet("outputs/madrid/panel/mad_zbs_full_allcovariates.parquet")
panels = bind_rows(catalunya = cat_panel, madrid = mad_panel, .id = "region")
```

## Coverage

Areas, days and missing values per region. Every count of missing values
should be zero inside this window.

```{r}
panels |>
	group_by(region) |>
	summarise(
		bha = n_distinct(id), days = n_distinct(date),
		first = min(date), last = max(date),
		cases = sum(new_cases, na.rm = TRUE),
		across(c(new_cases, trips_internal, trips_out, trips_in, moving_population, pop),
			\(x) sum(is.na(x)), .names = "na_{.col}")
	) |>
	knitr::kable()
```

## Cases and mobility over time

```{r}
#| fig-height: 6
panels |>
	group_by(region, date) |>
	summarise(`new cases` = sum(new_cases), `trips (all)` = sum(trips_internal + trips_out),
		.groups = "drop") |>
	pivot_longer(-c(region, date)) |>
	ggplot(aes(date, value)) +
	geom_line(linewidth = 0.3) +
	facet_grid(name ~ region, scales = "free_y") +
	labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
	theme_minimal()
```

## Catalunya vaccination

Population-weighted coverage across Catalunya, and the spread across ABS on
the last day.

```{r}
cat_panel |>
	group_by(date) |>
	summarise(across(c(vacc_dose1, vacc_complete), \(x) weighted.mean(x, pop))) |>
	pivot_longer(-date) |>
	filter(date >= as.Date("2020-12-01")) |>
	ggplot(aes(date, value, colour = name)) +
	geom_line() +
	scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
	labs(x = NULL, y = "share of population", colour = NULL) +
	theme_minimal()

cat_panel |>
	filter(date == max(date)) |>
	summarise(across(c(vacc_dose1, vacc_complete), \(x) list(quantile(x, c(0, .25, .5, .75, 1))))) |>
	unnest(everything()) |>
	mutate(q = c("min", "q25", "median", "q75", "max"), .before = 1) |>
	knitr::kable(digits = 3)
```

## Madrid reporting regime

Share of Madrid days with any reported case, by weekday and regime. Under the
weekly regime only Tuesdays should carry counts.

```{r}
mad_panel |>
	group_by(reporting, weekday = weekdays(date), date) |>
	summarise(any = sum(new_cases) > 0, .groups = "drop_last") |>
	summarise(share_nonzero = mean(any), .groups = "drop") |>
	pivot_wider(names_from = reporting, values_from = share_nonzero) |>
	knitr::kable(digits = 2)
```
